parts.text:
{{figure:fig_4_1.webp}}

The diagram shows the graph of the probability density function, $\text{f}$, of a random variable $X$. The graph is a straight line from $(0, a)$ to $(2, b)$, where $a$ and $b$ are positive constants. Elsewhere, $\text{f}(x) = 0$.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Given that $\text{E}(X) = 1.2$, find the value of $a$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
A random variable $T$ has probability density function given by

$$\text{g}(t) = \begin{cases} \frac{1}{2}\cos t & -\frac{1}{2}\pi \leqslant t \leqslant \frac{1}{2}\pi, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise.} \end{cases}$$

Find the value of $c$ such that $\text{P}(-c < t < c) = \frac{1}{2}$.
